item.description:
🇪🇪 🚨 ESTONIA: TAX AND CUSTOMS BOARD (EMTA) ALLEGEDLY BREACHED, 32GB OF GOVERNMENT DATA OFFERED ON DARK WEB FORUM

A threat actor on a dark web forum claims to be selling a 32GB dataset taken from the Estonian Tax and Customs Board (Maksu- ja Tolliamet), the national agency for taxes and customs.

The allegedly stolen data includes:
• ~98,800 files, about 32GB in total
• ~16,500 records of personal data
• Documents described as "secret state" procedures, service weapons and national defense material
• Cyber, customs and ministry documents, including signed orders and licences
• Employee CVs

The claim has not been independently verified.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a breach. The post lists file counts and categories but shows no data samples in the screenshot. If authentic, the defense- and weapons-related material would make this far more serious than a typical PII leak, and GDPR notification duties would apply.

item.description: VIDEO | Mahadev betting app case: Defence lawyer Tushar Giri says, “Saurabh Chandrakar was produced before the special CBI court in Raipur today. The CBI sought 10 days of remand, but the court granted eight days. The court also accepted some of our conditions, including access for lawyers to meet him, interrogation in the presence of CCTV cameras and permission for family members to meet him. At this stage, I do not want to make this argument a major issue, as we do not want to give the impression that we are creating obstacles in the investigation. We have raised our objections at the appropriate time. Our limited objection is that extradition laws, international treaties and bilateral agreements stipulate that a person can be tried, prosecuted or punished only for the offence for which they were extradited. Our submission is that, according to the judgments on record, Saurabh Chandrakar was extradited only in connection with the Enforcement Directorate's case, and not the CBI case. Therefore, our argument is that when he cannot be tried in the CBI case, the question of arresting him in that case does not arise.”

🌐 🚨 CRYPTO EXCHANGE ALPHAEX: THREAT ACTOR LEAKS ALLEGED 20GB KYC IDENTITY DOCUMENT DUMP

A threat actor on a dark web forum has posted what it claims is a 20GB set of more than 15,000 Know Your Customer (KYC) identity documents taken from cryptocurrency exchange AlphaEx.

The leak allegedly includes:
* Passport scans
* Driving licenses
* Government-issued ID cards
* Files the actor says were pulled from the exchange's own backend storage

⚠️ Analyst Note:
As proof, the poster shared direct links to image files that appear to sit on an AlphaEx API domain, which suggests storage that was reachable from outside. If real, people whose IDs are in the set face a higher risk of identity fraud, account takeover and targeted phishing. AlphaEx has not confirmed any incident that we are aware of. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a breach.

🌐 🚨 THREAT ACTOR ADVERTISES ARCHIVE OF 10M+ DISCORD USER PROFILE HISTORIES

A threat actor on a dark web forum is promoting what it calls a "database engine" of historical Discord profile data, claiming it covers more than 10 million users and lets buyers look up past changes on specific accounts.

The archive allegedly includes:
* Past usernames and display names
* Avatar and banner image history
* Profile change history per account

⚠️ Analyst Note:
The post does not explain how the data was collected. Archives like this are usually built by scraping public profile data or pulling from third-party logging bots, not from a breach of Discord itself. Even so, profile history lookups are a real risk for doxxing and for tracking people who changed names to stay private. Discord has not confirmed any incident that we are aware of. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a breach.

STORY | Govt approves strengthening, extension of 850 fast track courts to deal with child abuse and rape

The Union Cabinet on Wednesday approved the strengthening and extension of 850 fast track courts to deal with child abuse and rape cases, Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said.

Briefing reporters on decisions taken by the Cabinet, Vaishnaw said the Modi government is committed to firmly dealing with cases of atrocities against women and children.

He said the decision is part of efforts to fully utilise and implement prevailing laws and draft new legislations to deal with such cases.

The Centrally Sponsored Scheme for the establishment of Fast Track Special Courts (FTSCs), including exclusive POCSO (ePOCSO) courts, was introduced in October 2019, following the enactment of the Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2018, and the order of the Supreme Court.

These courts are dedicated to the time-bound trial and disposal of pending cases related to rape and crimes under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012.

A nine-year-old girl studying in class 3 at a school in east Delhi's Mayur Vihar died after suddenly collapsing inside her classroom on Wednesday morning, with CCTV footage capturing the incident, police said.

Police received a PCR call around 9.52 am, following which an investigation was initiated.

item.title: VIDEO | Sangrur, Punjab: Addressing 'Insaaf Rally', Congress MP Rahul Gandhi invites late singer Sidhu Moose Wala's father on the stage, says, "A few ...
item.description:
VIDEO | Sangrur, Punjab: Addressing 'Insaaf Rally', Congress MP Rahul Gandhi invites late singer Sidhu Moose Wala's father on the stage, says, "A few years ago, I met his son at my office. At that time, I did not know Sidhu Moose Wala. I was meeting him for the first time and did not know much about him. He was an impressive young man. He walked into the room with tattoos. I had not heard his songs or even his voice at that time. I was only told that he was a good person, a musician, and wanted to join the Congress party. As politicians, we observe people carefully when they come to meet us. We do not rely too much on their words; we go by our feelings and what our heart tells us about them. He was a dynamic and talented young man, so I inducted him into the party.
During our meeting, a thought suddenly crossed my mind, though nobody had told me anything about it. I felt that he was entering a dangerous field. I don't know why I got that feeling. He was a singer, a dynamic young man, and someone who did not understand politics very well. I felt I should protect him in my own way. I did not mean physical protection, that thought had not even crossed my mind. I meant political protection. He was a young man entering politics, and I wanted him to feel comfortable in that environment."

#RahulGandhi #Sangrur #PunjabNews #SidhuMoosewala

🇺🇸 🚨 SCARLETTGROUP CLAIMS ATTACK ON FIREARMS MAKER SIG SAUER

The ScarlettGroup threat actor has named SIG SAUER as a victim. SIG SAUER is a leading firearms manufacturer, making pistols, rifles, ammunition, optics and accessories for civilian, law enforcement and military customers.

The claim appeared on Nov 4, 2026 (UTC). No details on the volume or type of data allegedly taken have been shared so far.

The claim has not been independently verified, and SIG SAUER has not publicly confirmed a cyber incident.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
A breach at a major defense and law enforcement supplier could expose customer, dealer, employee and contract data. If the claim holds, staff, dealers and customers should watch for targeted phishing and impersonation attempts. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a breach.
